documentation_joins.before: The parcel-size threshold is therefore evaluated against the actual parcel size, while reporting-area quantities remain separately readable.
documentation_joins.after: The parcel-size threshold is evaluated against the full original parcel. New spatial source criteria also default to that full parcel through spatial_criteria_basis=whole_original_parcel. Select reporting_parcel explicitly for a reporting-boundary adaptation. Land-cover and floodplain-development bases remain independent choices. The generated table, source scope, CSV, GeoPackage and point report retain the actual criterion basis alongside the original full and reporting areas.

documentation_joins.after: The complete study stream-length mean is computed from positive original line lengths among the selected parcels under the same saved spatial_criteria_basis.

documentation_joins.before: For a parcel crossing the reporting boundary, full parcel size and the in-study hydric or riparian acreage remain separate.
documentation_joins.after: For a parcel crossing the reporting boundary, the table preserves full parcel area, reporting area and the actual source-criterion geometry independently. New operations default to full original parcel geometry for spatial criteria; reporting_parcel is an explicit saved adaptation. Prior completed tables retain their original basis.
